title: Library of Digital Latin Texts (LDLT) — Digital Latin Library
institution: Digital Latin Library, in collaboration with the Society for Classical Studies, the Medieval Academy of America, and the Renaissance Society of America
notes:
An open series of peer-reviewed critical editions published as single version-controlled TEI XML files, each with preface, critical text and scholarly apparatus. Coverage spans late antique, medieval and Renaissance Latin; the Renaissance portion falls within the catalogue's window. Distinct from 'The Latin Library' already in the catalogue.

Justification: A significant, ongoing series of TEI XML scholarly critical editions with explicit Renaissance-era coverage (co-published with the Renaissance Society of America), freely accessible and versioned on GitHub. Found via the TEI Consortium's list of projects using TEI and the LDLT encoding guidelines; not in the catalogue.
Found at: https://tei-c.org/activities/projects/the-digital-latin-librarys-library-of-digital-latin-texts/
